title: Matrix Reprogrammed Living Intelligence Machine
lockedDirection: MatrixReprogrammed is a living intelligence machine, not a static website.
mission: Connect decks, profiles, timelines, network maps, evidence records, public-source feeds, AI answer pages, books, videos, search and daily briefings into one self-updating public-record intelligence graph.
principles: Every card routes to a profile, timeline, evidence boundary, related cards, Atlas node, Evidence Vault lane, search, latest Intel and book/video paths.
No deck inclusion is treated as proof of wrongdoing, secret control, criminality, intent or unlawful conduct.
News items are leads, not verdicts.
Speculation is separated from public records and labelled clearly.
Every build should pressure-test links, data feeds, card routes, search, dashboards and deploy output.
nextUpgradePriorities: Install artwork across all existing decks.
Expand Deck II and Deck III profile pages into richer dossiers.
Add timeline, related-card and evidence-route blocks to every card profile.
Create machine health dashboard showing stale feeds, broken routes and update status.
Continue adding future 52-card decks into the same routing system.
